# REMAINING_WORK — Completion Gate Closed

The Awtsmoos renews each frame, while evidence makes the vessel bright;
Awtsmoos.com closes work not by feeling done, but when every promised gate is shown in light.

- [x] Discover every movie/animation-capable app and route in the requested surface.
- [x] Trace shared movie libraries, deterministic core, adapters, installers, and renderer dependencies.
- [x] Record the actual architecture and affected runtime paths.
- [x] Unify AI-authorable movie direction across Animator, Nesher Studio, Video Editor, Mitzvah Studio, and Captions.
- [x] Preserve distinct 2D, 3D, hybrid, NLE, spatial, and caption-oriented product personalities through adapters.
- [x] Verify mobile-first Director UX with viewport-safe bottom-sheet behavior and 44px visible controls.
- [x] Verify canonical scene vocabulary covering characters, text, 2D shapes/paths, infographics/tutorial semantics, particles, cameras, transitions, dialogue, and layered 2D/3D content.
- [x] Produce and retain a real 180-second multi-scene movie artifact.
- [x] Verify exact movie duration, codecs, dimensions, frame rate, and feature coverage programmatically.
- [x] Run the complete focused movie verification universe after final fixes.
- [x] Browser-test the affected movie apps through fresh foreground DevTools targets.
- [x] Verify 390×844 mobile behavior and desktop geometry.
- [x] Inspect runtime exceptions, console warnings/errors, failed requests, and 4xx responses in final clean witnesses.
- [x] Submit a real AI Director prompt and verify storyboard, timeline, and deterministic canvas output.
- [x] Seek the real 180-second showcase to 175s, play forward, pause, and verify late-scene rendering.
- [x] Remove Mitzvah Studio's Procedural Core root-barrel imports and protect the boundary with regression tests.
- [x] Decouple heavy native boot graphs from AI Director mounting where needed.
- [x] Re-read and statically audit every touched/new source file.
- [x] Compare original plan against actual implementation and resolve required-scope delta.
- [x] Update durable evidence and handoff material.

## Open user-scope work

None discovered after the final implementation, runtime, dependency, mobile, media, static, and takeover audits.
